question: For matchup 3 (Mon 2 to Sun 8 Nov, against Melbourne poopoo, projected 1,447 to 1,487), we will stream Fred VanVleet's slot (ESPN lists him out, right knee, est. 2 Nov, but he sat Saturday for rest on the second night of a back-to-back under Udoka's rule for him; he plays Mon, Wed and Sat next week). Which second player's slot should we also stream, dropping that player when the plan says, or should we stream VanVleet's slot only? council/matchup.py --next values: VanVleet + Bane +169.2 (6 adds), + Lendeborg +165.2, + Black +161.1, + Murphy +134.9, VanVleet alone +92.1 (4 adds). Matchup 3 allows 6 adds; matchup 2 has 2 adds left that can be used today (Sun 1 Nov US) for players who also play Monday.
constraints: The owner: Fred VanVleet is not a consideration in trades at all.

ballots.rationale: A second slot adds 69 to 77 points this week. That takes our projected margin from about +52 to about +121, worth roughly 0.17 of a win, so 'slot only' leaves value behind. Black's week gain (+161.1) is only 8.1 below Bane's and 4.1 below Lendeborg's. His 2026 baseline (30.64 FP/g over 64 games) equals the free agents we would stream (Gillespie 30.93, Watson 29.80, Gafford 28.14), so dropping him costs nothing measurable for the season. Bane (36.86 over 82 games) and Murphy (41.60 over 66 games) are well above that pool, and Lendeborg's 36.2 over 6 starts at 32 minutes looks safe while Golden State's injuries last.
